meanings: thigh, part of a whole, portion of a sum, (stock) share, strand of a thread, low-level administrative unit, translated as "section" or "department" etc, ranked below 科, classifier for long winding things like ropes, rivers etc, classifier for smoke, smells etc: thread, puff, whiff, classifier for bands of people, gangs etc, classifier for sudden forceful actions
malfunction, breakdown, defect, shortcoming, fault, failure, impediment, error, bug (in software)
surname Gu, to look after, to take into consideration, to attend to
to scrape, to blow, to shave, to plunder, to extort, to blow (of the wind)
to turn (a corner etc), to kidnap, to swindle, to misappropriate, seven (used as a substitute for 七), variant of 拐, cane, walking stick, crutch, old man's staff
